answer: Operator-Linked Resource Ledger. Each identity draws compute and API quota from a shared operator account; when correlated behavior flags a cluster, the ledger freezes the operator’s entire allocation, not individual wallets. An attacker cloning identities hits a marble ceiling: every new alias must provision from that same frozen pool, so the marginal clone yields zero extra capacity. Reinstatement requires a pearl of verifiable off-chain accountability, e.g., a signed legal entity. The bridge to recovery is costly: the operator pays full re-audit fees and forfeits accrued quota,
